decisions.reason: The ongoing monthly quota and personal-approval rule do not change the already completed task-local trial batch assignment.
The source changes the monthly approved-clip target and approval authority but does not change permitted source content or source-exclusion rules.
The dedicated Instagram account is independently introduced by another clause of the same message and is already fully represented; the quota change requires no additional modification.
Requiring personal approval and prioritizing quality does not modify or necessarily resume the concrete clean-editing style rules.
The revised quota and approval authority do not establish any new hook-selection criterion.
The general statement that substandard clips will not count does not alter or extend the specific moment-value standard.
Performance tracking is independently introduced and fully represented from the same message; changing the monthly approved-clip quota does not alter its metrics or coverage.
The source does not modify the complete, standalone narrative standard.
Personal approval of clips does not change the existing white-text-only and no-text-effects requirements.
The monthly quota decision does not change the requirement to use the exact brand-guideline font.
The source leaves the existing 20-to-120-second duration limits unchanged.
